newsitem.title: JAPAN: JGBs seen heading for 127 resistance.
newsitem.headline: JGBs seen heading for 127 resistance.

text.p: The JGB market is likely to be charged with energy to challenge the next resistance at 127 on Thursday on the back of numerous bullish factors for bonds, traders said.
On Wednesday, Japanese construction company Tada Corp applied for court protection under Japanese bankruptcy laws.

"JGBs will be supported by the bad loan problems at general contractors which should make the Bank of Japan even more wary of tightening its credit grip," said a senior trader at Japanese city bank's securities arm.
Outstanding call options on the key September at a price of 127 were growing larger.
If the September rises towards 127, demand to buy back JGBs would emerge from sellers of the call options which would fuel a rise in the September, traders said.
On Wednesday, the Trade Ministry said that Japan's industrial output in the July-September quarter is expected to rise 0.3 percent from the previous quarter.
The senior trader said that any recovery in production would only be modest because of a gradual rise in corporate inventories. --Tokyo Treasury Desk +81-3-3432-8676
